Prohibited: Combining /m:12 with /MP12 or enabling extra independent builds concurrently
Measurement: Elapsed time, full native exits/stdout/stderr, cl/link/MSBuild process tree, peak compile workers, CPU per logical processor, Available/Committed RAM, Pages/sec/PageReads/PageWrites, per-process private/working set, disk IO; sample once per second during the next necessary build
MemoryPolicy: Start with budget12, approximately15.5GiB free observed, heavy core TU peak is UNMEASURED. If sustained paging or AvailableRAM<4GiB for30s, record evidence and select a lower budget for a subsequent necessary build. Do not kill/retry a running build automatically.
